The '''Fentella Section''' was a suburb of [[Tazan City]] on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]]. It was located on the outskirts of the city, adjacent to the [[Industrial Belt]] and [[Bellmont Section]].
